    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingRequest" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingRequest"
                                   messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer by email or SMS"
                   messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice"
                           name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions?"
                           default="Flow_Company_6">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder"
                   name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"
                   messageRef="Message_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Reminder path complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyComplete" name="Booking processing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingDetails" name="Selected journey, personal information, and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TravelReminder" name="Travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingDetails"
                      name="Selected journey, personal information, and payment details"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket"
                      name="Ticket by email or SMS"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTicket"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TravelReminder"
                      name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReminder"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_TravelReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and travel" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SearchTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectRoute</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePersonalInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePaymentDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteJourney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostTravel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_JourneyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PostTravelComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Customer searches for a ticket">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvidePersonalInformation" name="Provide personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" name="Provide payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket by email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?" default="Flow_Customer_8">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyComplete" name="Journey complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInformation" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CompanyComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingRequest" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingRequest" messageRef="Message_BookingDetails"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Continue ticket delivery and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer by email or SMS" messageRef="Message_Ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Ticket delivery and inventory update complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderChoice" name="Send pre-travel reminders and instructions?" default="Flow_Company_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send pre-travel reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Message_TravelReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Reminder path complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CompanyComplete" name="Booking processing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Task_SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_9" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderChoice" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_10" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_CompanyComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant selects or specifies inputs before a subsequent process action: Model that selection or specification as an explicit task before the dependent action.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant selects or specifies inputs before a subsequent process action

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states an activity’s action, object, recipient, or multiple coordinated actions: Preserve those stated details in the BPMN task label rather than omitting or substituting them.
rules.situation: the description states an action, object, recipient, or direction of information transfer

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant supplies multiple distinct categories of information, even when they are mentioned in one combined step: Model each stated information-provision activity explicitly rather than combining distinct categories into a single activity.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant supplies multiple distinct categories of information, even when they are mentioned in one combined step

rules.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives: Model the activities as concurrent branches using a parallel gateway, and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before any subsequent activity that depends on all branches being complete.
rules.situation: the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives
